header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: and then the Prophet ﷺ said, “Say Allahu Akbar a hundred times; this is better than presenting a hundred fine camels with marking collars as a gift to the House of Allah. Say”La ilaha illallah' a hundred times. This is better for you than everything that the heavens and the earth encompass. And on that day no one's deed will be fit to be accepted by Allah Ta'ala as an accepted deed over and above your deed, except the deed of one who says this much or more than this!” — so it has come in another narration.And in yet another narration there are also the words: Keep saying La ilaha illallah. It does not leave any sin behind. There is no deed like it”.
blocks.source_reference_tamil: (Ibn Majah, Tabarani, Mustadrak Hakim, Musnad Ahmad, Majma' az-Zawa'id)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِهِ وَهُوَ يَغْرِسُ غَرْساً فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ! مَا الَّذِي تَغْرِسُ؟ قُلْتُ: غِرَاساً لِّي قَالَ: أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَي غِرَاسٍ خَيْرٍ لَّكَ مِنْ هذَا؟ قَالَ: بَلَي يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! قَالَ: قُلْ: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ يُغْرَسُ لَكَ بِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ شَجَرَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب فضل التسبيح رقم:٣٨٠٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) says, While I was planting a plant, the Prophet ﷺ passed by me. He asked, “Abu Hurairah! What are you planting?” I said, “I am planting a plant for myself.' He asked, “Shall I tell you of a plant better than this?” I said, “Please do tell me, Ya Rasulallah!' The Prophet ﷺ said, “Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar” — in return for each of these words, a plant will be planted for you in Jannah”.
